# Independent-producer compatibility fixture

`mupdf.pdf` is generated by **MuPDF 1.27.0**, not by rzpdf, from the accompanying
project-authored page descriptions and SVG. It is a controlled external-producer
sample, not a real-world business document or proof of general compatibility.
Source descriptions and artwork use the repository's license. No downloaded
document, private data, photo or font program is embedded. Helvetica is referenced
as a standard font; no external font binary is distributed in this fixture.

Rebuild from the repository root with `bash docs/generate-v01-fixture.sh`.
Regeneration overwrites only this fixture's generated PDF and PNG; tests consume
the checked-in PDF without requiring external tools or network access.

Generated on 2026-10-13:

- `mupdf.pdf`: SHA-256 `d24028ee2aa462ded454fa2953058fc0916d74075b8c293ca45c29346a63f103`.
- `pixels.png`: SHA-256 `a4cd715527b5dd3d6375bafd58d3121e0cd0823f9949e67cb04b1fb2f3476117`.

Two pages, MediaBox 240 × 160; page 2 rotates 90 degrees. Exact paint-order text
is `External producer - page 1` / `External producer - page 2`, font size 16.
First character display origins are (20, 40) and (120, 20), respectively.
Page 1 has a 2 × 1, 8-bit Flate image with red/blue RGBA pixels
`[255,0,0,255, 0,0,255,255]`, drawn at PDF user rectangle (20,30)–(100,70).
Its PNG-derived color space uses an ICC resource; rzpdf's current ICC support uses
Alternate rather than full profile color management.

`v01_workflow` checks strict parsing, exact text/positions, raw image metadata,
decoded samples, diagnostics and both save/reopen modes. Other deterministic tests
cover missing Unicode mappings and unsupported image filters separately; they
are not concealed as successful extraction from this valid fixture.
